WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_1)),0) ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_2)),0) ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACN_BALANCE_3)),0) ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_ATM_ACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,ACN_BALANCE_1 ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,ACN_BALANCE_2 ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,ACN_BALANCE_3 ACN_BALANCE_3_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_ATM_ACCOUNT WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,ACN_BALANCE_3_src
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,CAST(ACN_BALANCE_3_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACN_BALANCE_3_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,ACN_BALANCE_1_src
,ACN_BALANCE_2_src
,ACN_BALANCE_3_src )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,ACN_BALANCE_1_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_2_tgt
,ACN_BALANCE_3_tgt )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
